Leapblock closed our file on Feb 13 and reported 30 USD wires received totalling $407,944 (2023 $104,868 / 2024 $232,726 / 2025 $62,950 / 2026 $7,400). The by-year figures match the notices except 2023: the missing wire is their first one, $33,290 on Sep 13 2023, which has no Payment Processed notice in my mail. Per the counting rule their closeout beats the notices. By date that wire is Domino Delights, Build. Split: DD $337,594 / ZM $59,250 / CF $11,100.

Line is $37,056, not the $41,088 the notices add up to. The Apr 2 2024 wire of $4,032 to ***8605 came back (wrong account number, per Leonard in Slack) and Blake re-sent it to ***3341 on Apr 5, so the ***8605 notice is out. Build: DD $28,128 / ZM $8,928.

It was re-sent through Payoneer, but under the rule it only counts if a receipt reached my mail, and the only Payoneer mail I have is payment requests ("Video 1 of 4", $125). No receipt, so nothing counts. Marketing (ad videos), line kept at zero.
One notice, BGN 1,999.00 (Oct 30 2025), not dollars. The laptop is equipment, so Company. It stays in BGN next to the line and isn't added to any dollar total.

Done. Here's the page, counted the way your note says and laid out like your working sheet. It's shared with you and Blake: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1zoqHV0ONKC3ZjixkpRS6TSV2MsAe8cNKONtmQ_y4tFQ/edit

**What each bet cost to build** (Deel team plus studios and freelancers)
• Domino Delights: **$951,817.64**
• ZM: **$544,433.44**
• Combo Fighter: **$72,685.61**

**What each brought in** (lifetime, REVENUE_DAILY as recorded)
• Domino Delights: **$12,331.25**
• ZM: **$11.99**
• Combo Fighter: left off until we've checked its first sales

**What changes on the draft deck**
• Build cost slide: $985K / $609K / $74K becomes **$952K / $544K / $73K**
• Brought-in slide: "to fill in" becomes **DD $12.3K, ZM $12**, with Combo Fighter left off

Why it's lower than your quick pass (all USD notices by date):
• Marketing is now its own bucket. It's still listed under each bet by date but kept out of build cost: DD $16,428.57, ZM $56,537.06, CF $1,000.
• Company items (legal, trademark, website, Singular, the 4X help) are $49,625, plus BGN 1,999 for Martin's laptop. That stays in its own currency and isn't added in.
• Leapblock closed their file and reported $407,944. That's $33,290 more than the notices show, because their first wire (Sep 13 2023) has no notice. Their figure is used, and that wire goes to DD.
• Out of the count: the $4,032 MotMot wire to ***8605 that came back, Oleg's $125 that came back (no Payoneer receipt reached my mail), and the $4,000 to JPMorgan, which was our own Chase account.

All 22 payee issues in Payee history are moved to Done. The 5 where my number isn't what the notices add up to have a comment saying why.
